question: There are some friends, all less than 20 years. When paired amongst themselves they realize that the sum of their ages is a multiple of 5 . If their ages are distinct prime numbers, then the number of possible pairs are:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Prime numbers less than 20: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19.

For sum to be divisible by 5, group primes by their remainder when divided by 5.

Remainder 1 {11} & Remainder 4 {19} → 1 × 1 = 1 pair.

Remainder 2 {2, 7, 17} & Remainder 3 {3, 13} → 3 × 2 = 6 pairs.

Total possible pairs = 1 + 6 = 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ages are distinct prime numbers less than 20.

Sum of a pair of ages is a multiple of 5.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime numbers less than 20 are: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19

⇒ Now, we check distinct pairs (a, b) such that (a + b) is a multiple of 5 (i.e., 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30...)

⇒ Pairs with sum = 5: (2, 3) → 1 pair

⇒ Pairs with sum = 10: (3, 7) → 1 pair

⇒ Pairs with sum = 15: (2, 13) → 1 pair

⇒ Pairs with sum = 20: (3, 17) and (7, 13) → 2 pairs

⇒ Pairs with sum = 25: None

⇒ Pairs with sum = 30: (11, 19) and (13, 17) → 2 pairs

⇒ Total possible pairs = 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 0 + 2 = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Numbers

A prime number is a natural number greater than 1 that has exactly two distinct positive divisors: 1 and itself.

Divisibility Rule of 5

A number is divisible by 5 if and only if its last digit is either 0 or 5. When summing two numbers, their remainders modulo 5 must add up to a multiple of 5.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime or relatively prime if their highest common factor (HCF) is 1. All prime numbers are co-prime to each other.
